text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган doesn't show up for
training, so
I head out to look for her,
when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You seem pretty frazzled. Looking for
something?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Oh! Lemme guess... You're looking for
me,
aren'tcha?! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I know! Why don't you join us for
hide-and-seek.
We're in the middle of a
game right now. ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Huh? Of course I'm okay... Oh, wait.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Training, right? Did you get worried
when I didn't
show?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! That face—I didn't mean to
make you so
upset!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: Just be more careful next time.

text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'll try my best not to worry you! I
don't
want you looking like that ever
again!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
